FEATURED CASE · GOLD WEBSITE · SAUDI ARABIA

Almost 3× the clicks.
A wider search presence.

Google Search Console performance for a Saudi gold website: the last three months compared with the previous three months.

Explore the case +

The challenge

The website had recently undergone a migration. Its sitemap needed correction, and the site had very little content — leaving both technical foundations and topical coverage to be developed.

The work

  • Mapped old URLs to their relevant new destinations to support correct redirects and preserve existing link equity through the migration.
  • Corrected the sitemap and submitted it through Google Search Console.
  • Built a topical map and began writing content to expand coverage around relevant search topics.

Ongoing optimization

Product and category page optimization is still in progress.

The results

Comparing the last three months with the previous three months, Google Search clicks increased from 94.3K to 280K (approximately 197%), and impressions rose from 7.58M to 24M (approximately 217%). Average position improved from 5.4 to 4.6, while CTR remained at 1.2%.
